messages:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — Q3 roadmap for Retention & Keystore work. Need to lock MVP scope and launch criteria by EOD Friday so sales has a clear message.

Mike (Eng): /+1. Can we distill the top customer asks? I saw tickets for long retention + HSM integration.

Raj (CSE): Two enterprise deals asked for: 1) configurable audit-log retention up to 7 years (legal hold) and 2) ability to use customer HSM for key material. Both are blockers for procurement.

Sarah (Security): 7y retention is huge for hosted; cost and infra implications. We also need to define what counts as an "audit record" vs debug logs. For SOC2 evidence we need tamper-evident append-only storage + integrity checks.

Olivia (Legal): Also need legal-hold features: ability to mark a tenant and prevent deletion/retention expiry. That can be a separate feature but impacts data lifecycle.

Mike (Eng): Proposal for MVP (Q3):
- KMS integration (AWS KMS + GCP KMS) with envelope encryption for model/artifact keys
- Exportable audit logs to customer-owned S3/GCS buckets (30/90/365 day retention options)
- Legal-hold flagging as metadata (no auto-deletion) but UI/CLI will be basic
HSM (PKCS#11 / external HSM) and multi-year retention are v1.1 (enterprise add-on).

Anya (PM): That looks reasonable. Need explicit launch criteria we can agree on for product and security review.

Sarah (Security): Launch criteria (suggested):
1) KMS integration with rotation support + documented key-policy guidance
2) Audit logs emitted for these events: auth, token issuance, model deploys, inference requests (metadata only), key ops; logs validated by checksum every 24h
3) Export pipeline to customer bucket with ACLs and server-side encryption
4) Legal-hold prevents retention lifecycle truncation and is auditable
5) Threat model and SOC2 control mapping documented and reviewed

Olivia (Legal): Add: documented retention default, opt-in extended retention process (legal review), and export-ready chain-of-custody for audits.

Raj (CSE): Sales ask: we need a short checklist to show to prospects. Something like:
- Can we bring your key? Yes (KMS)
- HSM support? Planned (Q4)
- Retention >1yr? Enterprise add-on (design in Q3)

Mike (Eng): Tech notes / constraints: 
```
- We will not store raw PII in logs, only stable ids and metadata.
- Export throughput needs throttling, plan daily batches rather than streaming for cost.
- For tamper-evidence: store SHA256 chain in small ledger object and replicate to two regions.
```

Anya (PM): Timeline ask: Can Eng commit to KMS + export pipeline + legal-hold flag by end of Q3? (sprint allocation: 3 devs + 1 infra).

Mike (Eng): Blink. I can commit to KMS + basic export + legal-hold metadata in Q3 if we scope the audit retention to 365d for hosted. The 7y retention will blow costs and needs billing/archival plan.

Sarah (Security): OK, set hosted defaults to 365d, documented extension process for enterprise. We'll provide scripts to hash and verify logs; ops will run periodic integrity checks.

Anya (PM): Decision: MVP = KMS (AWS/GCP), exportable audit logs to customer buckets (up to 365d), legal-hold flagging, SOC2 mapping doc. HSM + multi-year retention deferred to Q4 and will be an enterprise add-on.

Raj (CSE): I'll update the RFP checklist and tell the two prospects the current commitment and expected Q4 timeline for HSM.

Olivia (Legal): I'll draft the legal-hold wording and retention appendix this week.

Mike (Eng): I'll open the epic and PRD with acceptance criteria above. Putting initial spike ticket for HSM integration for Q4.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging/api-keys-v2 -> 2028-05-12T03:00Z :rocket: (irrelevant but showing bot messages can appear)

Anya (PM): Thanks — action items captured. Can everyone add any missing acceptance criteria by tomorrow noon? :thumbsup:
